name: Chile

fees.name: Visa de Permanencia Transitoria Simple (single-entry consular tourist/business visa)
fees.validity: single entry, stay up to 90 days (shorter for some nationalities)
fees.applies: visa-required nationalities only; fee varies by nationality per official reciprocity table (USD 0-200)
fees.notes: Chile has no flat fee: the official 'Cuadro de Aranceles de Visas' sets a per-nationality USD amount (e.g. BGD $10, IND $42, PHL $40, PAK $122, NGA $200; $0 for China, Kazakhstan, Morocco, Tunisia, Palestine). Applied online via SAC (tramites.minrel.gov.cl) and issued by consulates; fee paid only if approved. Covers tourism and business visits. Official PDF: consulado.gob.cl/consulados/site/docs/20190220/20190220161313/cuadro_de_visas_corregido060326.pdf

fees.name: Visa de Permanencia Transitoria Múltiple (multiple-entry consular visa)
fees.validity: multiple entries, stay up to 90 days per entry (shorter for some nationalities)
fees.applies: visa-required nationalities only; fee varies by nationality per official reciprocity table (USD 0-258)
fees.notes: Multiple-entry fee per Art. 13 of Decreto Supremo N.296/2021 (Ministry of Interior). Examples: BGD $18, IND $76, PHL $88, PAK $202, NGA $208, Lesotho $258. Not available for some nationalities (e.g. Venezuela, Libya, Somalia only get single-entry).

reciprocity_variations.note: Single-entry USD 42 / multiple-entry USD 76, 90 days. EXEMPT from visa if holding a valid US visa (except C) or Green Card with 6+ months validity (since 01.04.2019).
Visa-free, 90 days (incl. British Overseas Territories listed in official table).
Visa required but fee USD 0 (gratis) for single and multiple entry, 90 days. Exempt from visa if holding a US/Canada visa (except transit) or Green Card with 6+ months validity.
Single-entry USD 200 (30-day stay) / multiple-entry USD 208 (60-day stay).
Single-entry USD 122 (30-day stay) / multiple-entry USD 202 (90-day stay).
Single-entry USD 40 (60-day stay) / multiple-entry USD 88 (90-day stay).

vfs.note: Chile does not outsource inbound visa processing to VFS/TLS/BLS; applications go through the official SAC online system (tramites.minrel.gov.cl) and Chilean consulates.

free_visa_notes: Most Western, Latin American and many Asian nationalities (~100 countries incl. USA, Canada, UK, EU, Australia, Japan, Russia) enter Chile visa-free for up to 90 days with no fee. The old airport 'reciprocity fee' (USD 117-160 for AUS/CAN/USA) was fully abolished (US 2014, Canada 2014, Australia Dec 2019). No e-visa product, no eTA, no visa on arrival; visa-required nationals must obtain the consular Permanencia Transitoria visa in advance. Chile is not a Schengen member.
